Position Summary
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join Novelle Analytics, a fast-growing enterprise AI division within a global B2B software company. The Senior Data Scientist will lead applied machine learning and analytics projects that translate complex business problems into production-grade data products. This role requires deep practical expertise in model development, end-to-end ML pipelines, and close collaboration with engineering and product teams to deploy robust, scalable solutions. The Senior Data Scientist will mentor junior team members, help define technical strategy, and contribute to improving MLOps and data platform capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Strategy
- Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through delivery, aligning modeling approaches with business objectives and KPIs.
- Define technical strategy and roadmap for data science initiatives within product lines, balancing innovation with operational reliability.
- Mentor and coach junior data scientists and analysts; establish best practices for modeling, validation, and code review.

Model Development and Research
- Design, implement, and evaluate predictive and prescriptive models using established statistical and machine learning techniques.
- Author reproducible, well-tested model code and documentation; iterate rapidly based on experimental evidence and stakeholder feedback.
- Conduct rigorous A/B testing, offline evaluation, and causal analyses to quantify model impact.

Productionization and Collaboration with Engineering
- Collaborate with ML engineers and data platform teams to productionize models and integrate them into microservices and data workflows.
- Ensure models meet production requirements for latency, throughput, monitoring, and versioning; partner on deployment automation and CI/CD.
- Implement robust data validation, feature pipelines, and model monitoring to detect drift and maintain model health.

Data Exploration and Feature Engineering
- Work with large, heterogeneous datasets to discover signals, design features, and build pipelines suitable for scale and real-time use.
- Translate business rules and domain knowledge into actionable features; perform feature selection and dimensionality reduction where appropriate.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
- Communicate technical approaches, results, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
- Produce clear reports and visualizations that demonstrate model performance, limitations, and recommended next steps.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 5+ years

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Python
- PyTorch
- SQL

- Proven track record of building and shipping machine learning models in production environments.
- Strong software engineering discipline: unit testing, code reviews, modular design, and reproducible experiments.
- Excellent problem-solving skills, with ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured data science projects.
- Strong communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Good-to-have skills
- Apache Spark
- Deep Learning

- Experience with model deployment frameworks and cloud platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Familiarity with feature stores, model monitoring tools, and MLOps best practices.
- Prior experience mentoring teams and establishing data science processes in an enterprise setting.

Success Metrics
- Delivery: Timely delivery of assigned projects and successful deployment of models into production according to roadmap milestones.
- Business Impact: Demonstrable improvement in business KPIs attributable to models (for example, conversion uplift, cost reduction, revenue increase).
- Quality and Reliability: Low production incidents related to model failures, solid test coverage, and robust monitoring in place.
- Team Enablement: Number of junior team members mentored, adoption of best practices, and contribution to improved team productivity.
- Innovation: Introduction of new modeling approaches, tooling, or processes that measurably improve modeling efficiency or performance.

Location and Work Mode
- Fully remote within India.
